parts.text: Which method gives a correct measurement?

options.text: Place the scale in contact along the chalk, look with the eye directly above the endpoint, and write the number with its unit.
Hold the scale far above the chalk and read the endpoint from the side of the desk.
Place the scale along the chalk but write only the number and leave out the unit.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Farhan measures the length of a straight chalk piece with a scale.

part_answers.answer: Correct length measurement needs the scale in contact along the object, the eye directly above the endpoint, and both the number and the unit written.

teacher.key_rationale: Place the scale in contact along the length, read with the eye directly above the endpoint, and report number plus unit. Side reading and omitting the unit introduce error.
